headline: Global Sites Face Millions of Cyberattacks Targeting Critical PHP Flaw
summary: Governments and corporations worldwide scrambled to patch a critical vulnerability in PHP, a programming language powering roughly 70% of websites. Millions of exploit attempts were detected, forcing organizations to take portals offline.
why: PHP underpins vast segments of web infrastructure, e-commerce, and enterprise applications. Systemic vulnerabilities expose critical digital services to remote server takeovers and operational disruption.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: Millions of automated server attacks trigger immediate enterprise spending on patching, detection, and endpoint defense.

impacts.name: Information Technology
impacts.why: Emergency outages and patching cycles disrupt corporate and public sector online services.
